root_cause_label: Wrong Mitigation Strategy: Disabling from_string + Undefined Class Inheritance + Post-Render Markup Wrap
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent chose a fundamentally broken SSTI mitigation path — disabling from_string entirely (breaking the framework), then introducing a SandboxedEnvironment inheriting from an undefined SecureEnvironment class, and finally wrapping rendered output in Markup which cannot prevent SSTI execution that already occurred during rendering.
t_err_evidence: Environment.from_string overridden to raise RuntimeError, breaking render_template_string entirely instead of escaping input.
t_commit_evidence: From step 3 onward the agent never reconsidered the fundamental approach; all subsequent edits (SandboxedEnvironment, Markup wrapping, signal removal) compound the wrong strategy without converging on a correct solution.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked the domain knowledge that SSTI mitigation requires treating user-supplied strings as data (context variables) rather than as template source code; it instead attempted to disable from_string and sandbox the environment, neither of which correctly addresses the vulnerability.
